note: Lists for getting ready to see a doctor. General advice written for this skill: no medical claim in it, and no database behind it. The diary columns are the ones references/features.md gives for the symptom diary.
first: Decide the one thing you most want from the visit, and say it first.
questions: What do you think is causing this, and what else could it be?
Do I need any tests? What will they show, and when do I get the results?
What are my options, and what happens if we wait and watch?
What should I look out for, and when should I come back or get urgent help?
Does anything change with the medicines I already take?
Is there anything I should do, or stop doing, in the meantime?
Who do I contact if it gets worse, or if it has not improved by when it should?
bring: A list of every medicine and supplement: name, strength, how you take it
Earlier results, letters or discharge notes that bear on this
Your questions, written down, the most important first
Whatever papers the clinic asks for at the desk
Someone you trust, if a second pair of ears helps
